passages.title: News Brief — Mazda CX-5 Full Redesign
passages.text:
TOKYO (May 24) — Mazda Motor Corporation unveiled a completely redesigned CX-5 today, the first major overhaul of the popular SUV in nine years. The new model (1)____ a hybrid powertrain across all trim levels, in line with the company's electrification roadmap.

Industry analysts (2)____ the redesign for some time, citing growing pressure from Korean and Chinese rivals in the family-SUV segment. Mazda President Masahiro Moro said the redesign (3)____ the company's commitment to its core customer base. (4)____ Pre-orders open at participating dealerships nationwide on June 1.

blanks.exp: 主語 The new model は単数で現在の事実なので features が正解。
for some time が継続を示すので現在完了 have expected が自然。
主節の that 節主語 the redesign は単数で現在の事実なので reflects が正解。

ch: The previous CX-5 generation will be phased out by the end of August.
Mazda's stock price fell sharply on the Tokyo Stock Exchange after the announcement.
All current CX-5 owners are eligible for a free first-year service plan.
Sales of the SUV are now restricted to overseas markets only.
blanks.exp: 発売の流れで前モデル終売情報を補足する A が自然。

passages.jp: 東京5月24日。マツダは本日CX-5を全面刷新、9年ぶりの大幅刷新。全グレードにハイブリッドパワートレイン搭載、電動化ロードマップに沿う。アナリストは韓中ライバルからの圧力増を背景に刷新を予想していた。毛籠勝弘社長は中核顧客への取組みを反映と述べた。旧CX-5は8月末で生産終了。先行予約は全国販売店で6/1開始。
passages.audio_text: TOKYO, May 24. Mazda Motor Corporation unveiled a completely redesigned C X 5 today, the first major overhaul of the popular S U V in nine years. The new model features a hybrid powertrain across all trim levels, in line with the company's electrification roadmap. Industry analysts have expected the redesign for some time, citing growing pressure from Korean and Chinese rivals in the family S U V segment. Mazda President Masahiro Moro said the redesign reflects the company's commitment to its core customer base. The previous C X 5 generation will be phased out by the end of August. Pre-orders open at participating dealerships nationwide on June 1.

passages.title: News Article — Power Asia Framework Launch
passages.text:
Prime Minister Takaichi announced the Power Asia framework at the Tokyo Summit on Monday, a multilateral initiative designed (5)____ regional energy security across the Indo-Pacific. Under the framework, participating nations will share strategic oil reserves and (6)____ coordinated responses to supply disruptions.

The announcement comes as global energy markets remain volatile (7)____ the ongoing Middle East tensions. (8)____ A working-level meeting of officials from Japan, South Korea, and Australia is scheduled for late June in Singapore.

blanks.exp: 目的・用途を表す to不定詞 to enhance が正解。
will share と並列の助動詞 will の後は原形 develop が正解。
後ろが名詞句 the ongoing Middle East tensions なので前置詞 amid が正解。

ch: Several Asian nations have expressed strong interest in joining the new framework.
The Tokyo Summit was originally scheduled to take place in Singapore.
Critics argue that Japan should focus on domestic renewable energy investment instead.
Prime Minister Takaichi has held office for just over six months.
blanks.exp: 6月の実務協議に繋ぐ流れで参加意向 A が論理的。

passages.jp: 高市首相は月曜の東京サミットでパワー・アジア構想を発表。インド太平洋のエネルギー安全保障強化を目的とした多国間枠組み。戦略石油備蓄共有と供給途絶への協調対応開発。中東情勢で世界エネルギー市場が揺らぐ中での発表。複数アジア諸国が参加に強い関心。日韓豪実務者協議は6月下旬シンガポール予定。
passages.audio_text: Prime Minister Takaichi announced the Power Asia framework at the Tokyo Summit on Monday, a multilateral initiative designed to enhance regional energy security across the Indo-Pacific. Under the framework, participating nations will share strategic oil reserves and develop coordinated responses to supply disruptions. The announcement comes as global energy markets remain volatile amid the ongoing Middle East tensions. Several Asian nations have expressed strong interest in joining the new framework. A working-level meeting of officials from Japan, South Korea, and Australia is scheduled for late June in Singapore.

passages.title: Press Release — Toyota Taiwan Production Plan
passages.text:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

Toyota Motor Corporation today announced that it will begin producing one of its Japan-bound models in Taiwan starting in October. The decision is intended (9)____ delivery times for domestic Japanese customers, who have faced wait periods of up to twelve months.

The Taiwan facility, operated by Toyota's longtime partner Hotai Motor, (10)____ an annual output of forty thousand units in its first year of operation. Vehicles will be shipped to Japan via dedicated transport routes (11)____ are expected to reduce overall logistics costs.

(12)____

blanks.exp: be intended to do の語法で to shorten が正解。
将来の生産目標を示す現在進行 is targeting が自然。
先行詞 routes(物) の主格関係代名詞は that または which。

ch: A detailed pricing announcement will be made closer to the production launch date.
Toyota has not produced vehicles outside Japan since 2018.
All workers at the Taiwan facility will be transferred from Japanese plants.
The company also confirmed plans to discontinue several minor product lines.
blanks.exp: プレスリリース末尾としては価格詳細発表予告 A が定型。

passages.jp: プレスリリース。トヨタは10月から日本向け車両の一つを台湾で生産開始すると本日発表。最大12ヶ月待ちだった国内顧客の納期短縮が目的。長年パートナーの和泰汽車運営の台湾工場、初年度年4万台目標。日本へは専用輸送ルートで出荷、全体物流コスト削減見込。詳細価格発表は生産開始直前に。
passages.audio_text: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE. Toyota Motor Corporation today announced that it will begin producing one of its Japan-bound models in Taiwan starting in October. The decision is intended to shorten delivery times for domestic Japanese customers, who have faced wait periods of up to twelve months. The Taiwan facility, operated by Toyota's longtime partner Hotai Motor, is targeting an annual output of forty thousand units in its first year of operation. Vehicles will be shipped to Japan via dedicated transport routes that are expected to reduce overall logistics costs. A detailed pricing announcement will be made closer to the production launch date.

passages.text:

A joint public-private task force was established this month to oversee the responsible use of the advanced AI system known as Mythos. The group (13)____ representatives from five government ministries and twelve private-sector firms.

The task force will publish its first set of guidelines (14)____ September of this year. Public comments will be accepted during a thirty-day consultation period (15)____ in early August. (16)____ Inquiries about the task force should be directed to the Cabinet Secretariat's digital governance desk.

blanks.exp: 主語 The group は単数で現在の事実なので includes が正解。
期限「〜までに」を表す by が正解。
consultation period を後置修飾する現在分詞 beginning が正解。

ch: Submissions can be made through the official government portal or by postal mail.

Several members of the task force were dismissed for failing to disclose conflicts of interest.

p7.title: TOEIC Test A — Part 7 (News Reading Comprehension)

singles.title: Sports article — Ohtani reaches 200 doubles
singles.text:
Shohei Ohtani reached the 200-doubles career milestone on Friday during the Dodgers' road series in Milwaukee. The two-bagger, which came in the seventh inning of a 4-3 victory over the Brewers, made him the second-fastest Japanese-born player to reach the mark.

Despite a difficult start to May, in which Ohtani hit just .129 over a ten-day stretch, the milestone signals a return to form. Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said in the post-game press conference that Ohtani's swing had looked sharper since the team's day off on Wednesday. The Dodgers are now tied for first place in the National League West division.

questions.q: In which inning did Ohtani hit his 200th double?
questions.exp: 「in the seventh inning」と明記。

questions.q: What does the article say about Ohtani's early May performance?
ch: He batted just .129 over ten days
questions.exp: 「hit just .129 over a ten-day stretch」。

questions.q: What does manager Dave Roberts say?
ch: Ohtani's swing has looked sharper recently
Ohtani will rest for the next series
The Dodgers have decided to trade Ohtani
Ohtani has signed a contract extension
questions.exp: 「Ohtani's swing had looked sharper since the team's day off」。

singles.jp: 大谷翔平が金曜のミルウォーキー・ロード戦で通算200本目の二塁打達成。7回、ブルワーズ戦4-3勝利の中で。日本人選手で2番目の早さ。5月不調(.129/10日)からの復調。デーブ・ロバーツ監督は水曜休養日以降スイングが鋭いと評価。ドジャースはナリーグ西地区首位タイ。

singles.title: Entertainment news — The Late Show ends after 10 years
singles.text:
The Late Show with Stephen Colbert ended its ten-year run on CBS this week with a special two-hour finale that featured tributes from former colleagues and surprise guest performances. By the time it was canceled earlier this year, the show had been on the air since September 2015.

Viewership for the finale was the highest the show had ever recorded, drawing approximately 4.2 million live viewers. CBS has not yet announced what programming will replace the show in the 11:35 PM slot, although industry insiders suggest a sports-themed talk show may be tested through the summer.

Colbert himself has stated that he plans to take a six-month break before announcing his next project.

ch: It featured tributes and surprise guests
It was broadcast live from London
It was the longest episode in TV history
It was followed by a documentary

A six-month break before his next project
A book tour starting in June

singles.title: Government notice — AI Mythos consultation
singles.text:
PUBLIC CONSULTATION NOTICE

The Cabinet Office invites public comments on draft guidelines for the responsible use of the advanced AI system known as Mythos. The consultation period will run for thirty days, beginning August 5 and closing on September 3.

Written submissions can be made through the official government portal at consultation.example.go.jp/ai-mythos. Submissions by postal mail should be addressed to the Digital Governance Desk, Cabinet Office. All submissions must include the submitter's name, affiliation, and contact information.

A summary report will be published within sixty days of the consultation's close. Specific questions about the guidelines can be directed to the Cabinet Office at ai-mythos@example.go.jp.

questions.q: When does the consultation close?
questions.exp: 「closing on September 3」と明記。

questions.q: What information must submissions include?
questions.exp: 「name, affiliation, and contact information」と明記。

questions.q: When will a summary report be published?
questions.exp: 「within sixty days of the consultation's close」と明記。

singles.jp: パブリックコンサルテーション通知。内閣府は高度AI『ミュトス』の責任ある活用に関する指針案へのパブコメを募集。期間は8/5-9/3の30日間。公式政府ポータル(consultation.example.go.jp/ai-mythos)からの書面提出可能、または郵送はデジタルガバナンス窓口宛て。提出に氏名・所属・連絡先必須。閉幕60日以内に要約報告書発表予定。質問は ai-mythos@example.go.jp。

singles.title: Economic news — U.S. gasoline prices at historic high
singles.text:
U.S. gasoline prices have surged to historic highs since early May, with the national average exceeding $4.85 per gallon for the first time in over two years. Industry analysts attribute the spike to a combination of unrest in the Middle East and seasonal demand ahead of the Memorial Day travel weekend.

Drivers in California and the Pacific Northwest are paying the most, with some stations reporting prices above $6 per gallon. The federal government has so far ruled out a release from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve, citing the need to preserve emergency stockpiles.

Industry forecasters expect prices to ease moderately by mid-July if Middle East tensions stabilize.

questions.q: What is the national average gasoline price?
questions.exp: 「national average exceeding $4.85 per gallon」。

questions.q: Why has the federal government NOT released from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve?
questions.exp: 「citing the need to preserve emergency stockpiles」。

questions.q: When are prices expected to ease?
questions.exp: 「by mid-July」と明記。

singles.jp: 米国ガソリン価格が5月初旬以来史上最高水準に高騰、ガロンあたり全米平均$4.85超え(2年超ぶり)。中東不安とメモリアルデー前需要が原因。カリフォルニア・太平洋北西部最高、一部$6/gal超。連邦政府は戦略石油備蓄(SPR)放出を見送り、緊急備蓄保護を理由に。中東安定なら7月中旬までに緩和予測。

singles.title: Diplomatic news brief — Trump-Iran peace framework
singles.text:
President Trump announced a peace framework on Thursday that, according to the administration, will end the months-long military conflict with Iran. The framework includes a phased reduction of U.S. military operations in the region and a comprehensive inspection regime for Iran's nuclear facilities.

Iranian officials confirmed they had received the proposal and would respond within ten business days. Several European foreign ministers welcomed the development but expressed concern about the proposed inspection timeline, which they characterized as 'optimistic.'

A full text of the framework is expected to be released after both governments complete internal reviews.

questions.q: What does the framework include?
ch: A complete withdrawal of all U.S. forces
Phased reduction of U.S. operations and inspections
A new arms sale to Israel
questions.exp: 「phased reduction of U.S. military operations ... and a comprehensive inspection regime」。

A new multilateral energy security framework launched by Japan on May 24. Member nations agree to share strategic petroleum reserves and develop coordinated responses to supply disruptions in the Indo-Pacific.

singles.text:
Daily trading volume on the Tokyo Stock Exchange's Prime Market is now twice as high as a year ago, according to data released this week. Average daily volume has exceeded 10 trillion yen for three consecutive weeks, a sign that both domestic and international investors are increasingly active in the Japanese market.

Analysts attribute the surge to a combination of corporate-governance reforms, weaker yen positioning, and inflows from overseas pension funds. Skeptics caution that the volume increase has not been accompanied by a proportionate rise in long-term holdings, suggesting much of the activity may be short-term speculation.

A more detailed quarterly analysis is expected in early July.

passages.title: Sports News — Nishikori Retirement
passages.text:
TOKYO — Kei Nishikori, the highest-ranked Japanese tennis player in the men's professional history, announced his retirement at age thirty-six on May 1. The announcement (1)____ during a press conference at the Japan Tennis Association headquarters.

Nishikori, who reached a career-high singles ranking of fourth in the world (2)____ 2015, said his decision to retire was influenced by long-standing injuries. He plans to remain involved in the sport through a new tennis academy (3)____ open later this year in his hometown.

Tennis fans across Asia have expressed both sadness and gratitude on social media.

singles.title: Travel news — Record Memorial Day traffic
singles.text:
Record Travel Predicted for Memorial Day Weekend

The American Automobile Association estimates that more than 44 million Americans will travel at least 50 miles from home this Memorial Day weekend, the highest figure on record. Of those, roughly 38 million will travel by car, despite gasoline prices reaching historic highs.

Air travel is also expected to set a new holiday record, with the Transportation Security Administration projecting 18 million screenings between Thursday and Monday. To handle the surge, several major airports have announced extended pre-clearance hours and additional security lanes.

Drivers are encouraged to avoid Thursday afternoon and Friday morning, when congestion is forecast to peak.

singles.title: Political news — Gabbard resignation
singles.text:
Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard announced today that she will step down from her position effective the end of June, citing personal family reasons. Gabbard has held the role since January and has been responsible for coordinating intelligence-sharing across seventeen U.S. agencies.

In her resignation statement, Gabbard expressed gratitude to her staff and confirmed that she will support a smooth transition. The White House has indicated that an interim director will be appointed within the next ten days, with a permanent successor to follow after Senate confirmation.

Several senators from both parties have praised Gabbard's bipartisan approach during her tenure.

An interim director will be appointed

singles.title: Technology news — Switch 2 detailed pricing
singles.text:
Nintendo Confirms Switch 2 Pricing at 59,980 Yen

Nintendo confirmed today that the upcoming Switch 2 console will be sold at an introductory price of 59,980 yen, significantly higher than the original Switch's launch price of 29,980 yen. The company attributed the increase to upgraded internal hardware, including a new custom GPU and significantly more memory.

A bundled set including the console, a carrying case, and three first-party games will be available for 74,980 yen. Pre-orders open at participating retailers next week, with launch date set for late August.

The original Switch will continue to be produced and sold at a reduced price of 19,980 yen through at least the end of the year.

singles.title: International news — UN concern over Taliban marriage law
singles.text:
UN Expresses Concern Over New Taliban Marriage Law

The United Nations expressed grave concern this week over a new law issued by Afghanistan's Taliban government regarding marriage and separation. According to UN officials, the law includes provisions that effectively legalize child marriage in some interpretations and limit women's ability to seek separation in cases of domestic abuse.

The UN Secretary-General called on the Taliban authorities to review and amend the law in light of international human-rights standards. Several Asian and European nations have endorsed the UN statement, while regional women's-rights organizations have called for stronger sanctions.

The Taliban government has not yet issued a formal response.

singles.title: Health news — Congo Ebola outbreak
singles.text:
Healthcare workers in eastern Congo are struggling to contain a rapidly spreading outbreak of a rare type of Ebola virus, which has so far infected at least 230 people and resulted in at least 95 deaths. The World Health Organization has dispatched additional medical teams and supplies to the region.

Local hospitals report critical shortages of personal protective equipment and ventilators. Healthcare workers themselves are increasingly at risk, with eighteen confirmed infections among hospital staff in the past two weeks.

WHO officials warn that the outbreak could spread to neighboring countries if containment efforts are not strengthened immediately.

singles.title: Legal news — Retrial system reform
singles.text:
The Japanese government announced a major reform to the retrial system this week, intended to prevent further wrongful convictions. Under the proposed changes, prosecutors will be largely prohibited from appealing decisions that order a retrial, and disclosure of evidence will be required at earlier stages.

Legal advocates, including the Japan Federation of Bar Associations, have welcomed the reform but noted that key implementation details, such as funding for evidence-disclosure infrastructure, remain unresolved.

The proposed reforms will be submitted to the Diet for deliberation in the autumn session, with a target enactment date in early 2027.

questions.exp: 「funding for evidence-disclosure infrastructure, remain unresolved」。

questions.q: When is the target enactment date?
questions.exp: 「target enactment date in early 2027」。

singles.title: Tech news — Civil court fully digitized
singles.text:
Japan's civil court system has completely digitized all procedures, from filing a case through final judgment, under a new policy launched this month. The Supreme Court announced that all participating courts now offer fully online filing, virtual hearings, and electronic delivery of judgments.

While lawyers have generally welcomed the convenience, some observers caution that older or rural users may face access challenges. To address this concern, the Supreme Court has opened twenty support centers across the country where staff can assist users with the new digital system free of charge.

A hybrid option is also available for users who prefer in-person interactions at the courthouse.

singles.title: Business news — Sanrio earnings postponement
singles.text:
Sanrio Postpones Earnings Announcement Over Compensation Concerns

Sanrio Holdings has postponed its annual earnings announcement, citing the need for a special investigation committee to review issues related to allegedly improper executive compensation practices. The committee is expected to deliver its findings within sixty days.

The original earnings date was scheduled for next week. A new date has not yet been set, but the company has assured shareholders that the postponement is procedural and does not reflect a change in business performance.

The company's stock price fell approximately four percent in trading following the announcement.

singles.title: Consumer news — Pokemon card ID verification
singles.text:
Pokemon Company Japan announced this week that starting in August, online purchases of selected popular trading-card products will require buyers to verify their identity using a My Number card or similar government-issued ID. The company stated that the measure is intended to combat resellers and bot-driven bulk purchases.

Each verified account will be limited to one purchase of premium sets per month. Resold cards detected on secondary marketplaces may result in the seller's account being permanently banned.

The Pokemon Company has worked closely with the government's Digital Agency to design the verification flow, and officials have praised the model as a potential template for other high-demand consumer products.

singles.text:
BRIEFING: Quad Foreign Ministers' Meeting

The Quadrilateral Security Dialogue (Quad) — Japan, India, Australia, and the United States — held its latest foreign ministers' meeting in New Delhi this week. Secretary of State Marco Rubio represented the United States.

Key discussion topics included maritime security in the Indo-Pacific, supply-chain resilience for critical minerals, and humanitarian-assistance coordination during natural disasters. A joint communique was released on the second day, although a separate technology-cooperation annex remains under negotiation.

The next ministerial meeting is scheduled for Tokyo in November.

passages.label: News article
passages.text:
Toyota to Begin Taiwan Production of Japan-Bound Model

Toyota Motor Corporation announced this week that it will begin producing one of its Japan-bound models in Taiwan starting in October. The decision is intended to shorten delivery times for domestic Japanese customers, who have faced wait periods of up to twelve months. The Taiwan facility, operated by Toyota's longtime partner Hotai Motor, is targeting an annual output of forty thousand units in its first year.

Vehicles will be shipped to Japan via dedicated transport routes that are expected to reduce overall logistics costs by approximately eighteen percent. Toyota has not yet specified which model will be produced under this arrangement.

passages.label: Analyst commentary
passages.text:
From: Reina Watanabe, Auto Industry Analyst, Edomae Securities
To: Subscribers
Subject: Toyota Taiwan production — three observations

Dear Subscribers,

Following Toyota's announcement of Taiwan-based production for a Japan-bound model, I see three implications worth tracking:

(1) Margin impact: Lower logistics costs could improve domestic gross margin by 0.5 to 1.0 percentage point if the move covers high-volume models.
(2) Capacity: Hotai's announced 40,000-unit target represents about 2 percent of Toyota's domestic volume — modest but meaningful for queue reduction.
(3) Geopolitical: Increased Toyota presence in Taiwan could affect the company's relationship with mainland China; we recommend close monitoring of any policy response.

My full report will be circulated to institutional subscribers by next Wednesday.

passages.label: News article
passages.text:
Nintendo Confirms Switch 2 Launch Details

Nintendo will release the Switch 2 console worldwide on August 23 at an introductory price of 59,980 yen in Japan and equivalent prices in other markets. A bundled set including the console, a carrying case, and three first-party games will be available for 74,980 yen.

Pre-orders open on June 15 through authorized retailers. To prevent bot-driven scalping, Nintendo will limit each customer to one console and one bundle, and orders must be picked up in person on launch day. The original Switch will continue to be produced and sold at a reduced price of 19,980 yen through at least the end of the year.

Line of customers are already expected at major retailers, despite the limit.

passages.label: Retailer notice
passages.text:
NOTICE TO CUSTOMERS — Major Electronics Retailer

We are pleased to confirm Switch 2 pre-orders will be accepted at our Tokyo, Osaka, and Nagoya flagship stores starting June 15 at 9:00 AM. Each customer may pre-order one Switch 2 console OR one bundled set, but not both.

Valid government-issued photo ID will be required at the time of pickup on August 23. Customers who fail to pick up their orders by 5:00 PM on August 25 will forfeit their reservation, and the units will be released to a waiting list.

In line with Nintendo's policy, our staff will randomly verify selected reservations against secondary-market resale records. Reservations linked to detected resale activity may be canceled without notice.

triples.title: Boeing-China deal: article + dealer memo + email

passages.label: News article
passages.text:
China-U.S. Trade Deal Includes 200 Boeing Aircraft Order

As part of the trade package announced this week, China agreed to purchase 200 Boeing aircraft over the next three years, the largest single Boeing order from a Chinese carrier since 2017. The deal is valued at approximately twenty-four billion U.S. dollars and will primarily involve narrow-body 737 MAX jets.

Delivery will be phased: roughly 60 aircraft per year over the first three years, with the first batch scheduled for late 2027. Boeing stated that delivery slots will be reallocated from other waiting carriers where necessary, and affected carriers will be offered priority on subsequent build slots.

passages.label: Internal memo from Boeing Asia-Pacific
passages.text:
INTERNAL MEMO — Boeing Asia-Pacific Sales Team

Following the China-U.S. trade deal announcement, please be aware of the following talking points when speaking with current and prospective customers:

1. The 200-aircraft order will be filled primarily from existing 737 MAX production capacity. We do not anticipate establishing a new assembly line for this order.
2. Carriers waiting for previously confirmed slots may experience delays of 6 to 12 months. Account managers should reach out to affected customers within the next ten business days.
3. As a goodwill measure, Boeing will offer affected customers a 5 percent discount on parts purchases through 2028. Specific details will be communicated in the formal customer letter.

passages.text:

Subject: Impact of China deal on our 737 MAX order

Could you confirm whether and by how much our delivery dates will shift? If a delay is unavoidable, what compensation or priority arrangements are available to us? We would also appreciate any information on the parts-discount goodwill measure mentioned in industry press.

Thank you,
Mei Wong

questions.exp: 後続の引用 'a little bit of movement' (わずかな前進) と整合する形容詞は modest (控えめな)。substantial (相当な) は逆、irrelevant (無関係な)・unanimous (満場一致の) は文意不適。

questions.q: The new ferry route between Hakata and Busan offers a _____ alternative to longer flight connections via Tokyo.
questions.jp: 博多-釜山間の新フェリー航路は、東京経由の長時間乗継便に対する便利な代替手段を提供しています。
questions.exp: alternative (代替) を修飾するのに最適は convenient (便利な)。sufficient (十分な)・numerous (多数の: 可算複数のみ)・apparent (明らかな) は意味/数の整合性で不適。

questions.q: The conference organizers will _____ the registration deadline by one week due to high demand from international attendees.
questions.jp: 会議の運営側は海外参加者からの高い需要を受けて登録期限を1週間延長します。
questions.exp: the registration deadline を目的語に取り、文意「期限を延ばす」→ extend が正解。exclude (除外する)・exhibit (展示する)・exclaim (叫ぶ) は意味不適。

questions.q: The committee carefully considered all proposals before reaching a _____ decision on the next round of funding.
questions.jp: 委員会は全提案を慎重に検討した上で、次回助成について全会一致の決定に達しました。
questions.exp: 空所後 decision (名詞) を修飾する形容詞が必要。unanimous (形容詞) が正解。unanimously (副詞)・unanimity (名詞)・unanimousness (名詞) は名詞修飾不可。

questions.q: Customer satisfaction scores have improved _____ since the company introduced its new feedback system last year.
questions.jp: 昨年フィードバック・システム導入以来、顧客満足度スコアが大幅に改善しています。
questions.exp: 空所は完了形動詞 have improved を修飾する副詞が必要。significantly (副詞) が正解。significant (形容詞)・significance (名詞)・signify (動詞) は副詞位置に不可。

questions.q: The training program offers _____ guidance on how to handle complex customer service situations.
questions.jp: その研修プログラムは複雑な顧客サービス状況への対処について実用的な指導を提供します。
questions.exp: 空所後 guidance (名詞) を修飾する形容詞が必要。practical (形容詞: 実用的な) が正解。practice (名詞/動詞)・practically (副詞)・practitioner (名詞) は形容詞位置に不可。

questions.q: All sales _____ are required to attend the monthly product training session at headquarters.
questions.jp: 全営業担当者は本社の月例製品研修への出席が必要です。
questions.exp: 主語 All sales ____ + are で複数主語の名詞が必要。representatives (複数名詞) が正解。represent (動詞)・representing (動名詞/分詞)・representative (単数名詞: are と数が不一致) は不適。

questions.q: The chairman responded _____ to questions from shareholders during the annual meeting.
questions.jp: 会長は年次株主総会で株主からの質問に思慮深く応えました。
questions.exp: 空所は動詞 responded を修飾する副詞が必要。thoughtfully (副詞) が正解。thought (名詞/動詞過去形)・thoughts (名詞複数)・thoughtful (形容詞) は副詞位置に不可。

questions.q: The proposal includes a _____ review of the company's energy-efficiency measures over the past five years.
questions.jp: その提案は過去5年間の同社省エネ対策に関する同等の振り返りを含みます。
questions.exp: a + ____ + review で名詞 review を修飾する形容詞。comparable (比較可能な/同等の) が正解。compare (動詞)・comparably (副詞)・comparison (名詞) は形容詞位置に不可。

questions.q: The IT department has streamlined the password reset process to make it more _____.
questions.jp: IT部門はパスワードリセットの手続をもっと有用にするよう合理化しました。
questions.exp: more + ____ で形容詞比較級の構造。more useful が正解。user (名詞)・users (名詞複数)・usefulness (名詞) は形容詞でないため不可。

questions.q: The new policy on remote work has been _____ welcomed by employees across all divisions.
questions.jp: テレワークに関する新方針は全部門の従業員に広く歓迎されています。
questions.exp: 空所は過去分詞 welcomed を修飾する副詞。widely (副詞) が正解。wide (形容詞/副詞だが意味不適)・widen (動詞)・widest (形容詞最上級) は不可。

questions.q: The chef has earned international _____ for her innovative approach to traditional Japanese cuisine.
questions.jp: そのシェフは伝統的な和食への革新的アプローチで国際的な評価を獲得しています。
questions.exp: earned + international + ____ で形容詞 international が修飾する名詞が必要。recognition (名詞) が正解。recognize (動詞)・recognized (過去形/分詞)・recognizing (動名詞) は名詞でない。

questions.q: All visitors should sign in at reception and wear their _____ badges at all times.
questions.jp: 訪問者全員は受付で記帳し、ビジター・バッジを常時着用してください。
questions.exp: 空所後 badges (名詞) を修飾する。複合名詞 visitor badges (名詞+名詞) が標準形。visit (動詞)・visitor's (単数所有格)・visitors' (複数所有格) は会社支給品の文脈で不自然。

questions.q: The marketing team meets _____ on Tuesday mornings to review campaign performance.
questions.jp: マーケティングチームはキャンペーン実績レビューのため毎週火曜午前に定例で集まります。
questions.exp: 空所は動詞 meets を修飾する副詞。regularly (副詞) が正解。regular (形容詞)・regularity (名詞)・regulars (名詞複数) は副詞位置に不可。

questions.q: The cause of the recent NASCAR driver's death was revealed by the family _____ severe pneumonia complicated by sepsis.
questions.jp: 最近のNASCARドライバーの死因は、敗血症を合併した重度の肺炎だったと家族により明らかにされました。
questions.exp: reveal A as B (AをBとして明らかにする) の語法。as が正解。with (〜とともに)・into・onto は文意不適。

questions.q: The Power Asia framework will require member nations _____ strategic petroleum reserves with each other.
questions.jp: パワー・アジア構想は加盟国に互いの戦略石油備蓄を共有することを求めます。
questions.exp: require A to do の語法で to不定詞 to share が正解。share (原形)・sharing (動名詞/分詞)・shared (過去分詞) は require + 目的語 の後に置けない。

questions.q: _____ the morning of June 8, all approved delegates must collect their accreditation badges from the front office.
questions.jp: 6月8日の午前中に、認定代表者全員は窓口でバッジを受け取らなければなりません。
questions.exp: 特定の日付 (the morning of June 8) を示すには on が正解。at は時刻、in は月/年/季節、until は継続限界。

questions.q: The conference's main agenda items _____ approved during last Friday's preparatory meeting.
questions.jp: 会議の主な議題は先週金曜の準備会で承認されました。
questions.exp: 主語 items (複数) + last Friday (過去) で複数過去形 were が正解。was (単数過去)・is (単数現在)・are (複数現在) は数または時制で不適。

questions.q: _____ the company's strict no-refund policy, the customer was allowed to exchange the defective product.
questions.jp: 会社の厳格な返金不可方針にもかかわらず、顧客は不良品の交換が許可されました。
questions.exp: 空所後 the company's strict ... policy (名詞句) なので前置詞句 Despite が正解。Because・Since・Although は接続詞で節 (S+V) を要する。

questions.q: _____ the renovation work concludes next week, we will reopen the second-floor cafeteria.
questions.jp: 来週改装工事が終了したらすぐ、2階の食堂を再開します。
questions.exp: 後ろに節 (the renovation ... concludes) を取り、文意「〜したらすぐ」を表す Once が正解。Despite は前置詞、Unless (〜でない限り)・Until (〜まで) は文意不適。

questions.q: The shareholders _____ on a new auditing firm at the special meeting held last Thursday.
questions.jp: 株主は先週木曜日の特別総会で新監査法人を決定しました。
questions.exp: 明確な過去 (last Thursday) があるため単純過去 decided が正解。decide (現在)・have decided (現在完了は明確過去と不可)・will decide (未来) は時制不一致。

questions.q: By the time the cruise reaches Singapore next month, it _____ over twelve thousand nautical miles.
questions.jp: クルーズ船が来月シンガポールに到着する頃には、累計1万2千海里を航行していることになります。
questions.exp: By the time + 未来動作 (reaches) で主節は未来完了 will have covered が必須。covers (現在)・covered (過去)・has covered (現在完了) は時制不一致。

questions.q: If the contract _____ signed by this Friday, the project launch will be delayed by two weeks.
questions.jp: 今週金曜までに契約が締結されない場合、プロジェクト開始は2週間遅れます。
questions.exp: if節は条件で現在形が原則。主節が未来形 will be なので If節は現在形受動 is not signed が正解。

questions.q: The new training program is designed _____ junior staff with practical leadership skills.
questions.jp: 新しい研修プログラムはジュニアスタッフに実践的なリーダーシップスキルを身につけさせるよう設計されています。
questions.exp: be designed to do の語法で to不定詞 to equip が正解。equip (原形)・equipped (過去分詞)・equipping (動名詞/分詞) は be designed の後で不可。

p6.title: TOEIC Test C — Part 6 (5/25最新ニュース)

passages.title: Diplomatic news — Iran-US Hormuz negotiation
passages.text:
WASHINGTON (May 25) — President Trump said today that a peace deal with Iran (1)____ the Strait of Hormuz to commercial shipping has been 'largely negotiated.' Secretary of State Marco Rubio noted (2)____ progress has been modest but tangible.

The blockade of the Strait, now in its hundredth day, has affected more than (3)____ commercial vessels. (4)____ A formal announcement is expected within the week, the administration said.

blanks.exp: deal を後置修飾し将来の意味を表す to不定詞 to reopen が正解。
noted の後ろに名詞節を導く that が正解。
more than の後ろに『何百もの』複数を表す hundreds of が正解。hundred / one hundred / a hundred は単数で more than と組み合わせると不適。

ch: Negotiations are being mediated by Pakistani officials in Islamabad.
Iran has not yet officially responded to the latest U.S. proposal.
The Strait of Hormuz handles about twenty percent of global oil trade.
All previous trade agreements between the two countries remain in force.
blanks.exp: 末尾「正式発表は1週間以内」に繋ぐには、現状『イラン回答待ち』を述べる B が自然。

passages.jp: ワシントン5月25日。トランプ大統領は本日、商船航行のためホルムズ海峡を再開するイランとの和平合意は『おおむね交渉済み』と述べた。ルビオ国務長官は進展はささやかだが具体的と評価。100日目の海峡封鎖は数百隻の商船に影響。イランからの公式回答は未定。週内に正式発表予定と政権発表。
passages.audio_text: WASHINGTON, May 25. President Trump said today that a peace deal with Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz to commercial shipping has been largely negotiated. Secretary of State Marco Rubio noted that progress has been modest but tangible. The blockade of the Strait, now in its hundredth day, has affected more than hundreds of commercial vessels. Iran has not yet officially responded to the latest U S proposal. A formal announcement is expected within the week, the administration said.

passages.title: Entertainment news — Cannes Palme d'Or
passages.text:
CANNES — Romanian director Cristian Mungiu won the Palme d'Or at this year's Cannes International Film Festival for his film Fjord, an intimate drama (5)____ a family reunion in northern Norway.

The award (6)____ Mungiu his second Palme d'Or, the first being for 4 Months, 3 Weeks and 2 Days in 2007. Distribution rights for the film (7)____ already been sold in over forty markets. (8)____

blanks.exp: 先行 drama を後置修飾する現在分詞 exploring が正解。
主語 The award + 過去 (last week受賞) なので過去形 made が正解。make A B = AをBにする。
主語 rights (複数) + already + been (過去分詞) で現在完了受動 have been。have が正解。

ch: A North American theatrical release is planned for early autumn.
The festival was attended by approximately one hundred journalists this year.
Mungiu has previously stated that he does not enjoy attending awards ceremonies.
The previous Palme d'Or winner was a documentary about deep-sea exploration.
blanks.exp: 配給権販売の文に続けて公開予定 A が自然な流れ。

passages.jp: カンヌ。ルーマニアのクリスティアン・ムンジウ監督が今年のカンヌ国際映画祭でパルム・ドール受賞。受賞作『Fjord』は北ノルウェーの家族再会を描く親密なドラマ。これでムンジウは2度目の受賞 (1度目は2007年『4ヶ月、3週と2日』)。配給権は40以上の市場で既に売却済み。北米劇場公開は秋初予定。
passages.audio_text: CANNES. Romanian director Cristian Mungiu won the Palme d'Or at this year's Cannes International Film Festival for his film Fjord, an intimate drama exploring a family reunion in northern Norway. The award made Mungiu his second Palme d'Or, the first being for 4 Months, 3 Weeks and 2 Days in 2007. Distribution rights for the film have already been sold in over forty markets. A North American theatrical release is planned for early autumn.

passages.title: Auto industry news — Toyota Taiwan partnership
passages.text:
Toyota Motor Corporation today (9)____ a new partnership agreement with Hotai Motor of Taiwan that will see one of Toyota's Japan-bound models produced (10)____ Taipei beginning in October. The agreement, valued at approximately fifteen billion yen, (11)____ the largest single overseas-production contract Toyota has signed in five years.

(12)____ The first units off the Taiwan production line are expected to ship to Japan in late November.

blanks.exp: today は過去示唆、主節動詞は過去形 signed が正解。
Taipei (都市) を示すには in / near のどちらか。地理的近接を強調する文脈で near が自然。
主語 The agreement (単数) + 現在の事実なので 3単現 represents が正解。

ch: The model to be produced has not yet been publicly identified.
Hotai Motor was founded in 1947 and is publicly listed in Taipei.
Toyota's Hiroshima plant currently produces approximately forty thousand units per year.
The new partnership will not affect Toyota's existing supplier relationships in Japan.
blanks.exp: 末文の『11月後半に第1ロット出荷予定』に繋ぐには、生産モデル未公表 A が論理的補足。

passages.jp: トヨタは本日、台北の和泰汽車との新パートナーシップ協定に署名、日本向けモデルの一つを10月から台北近郊で生産する。約150億円規模で、トヨタが過去5年で結んだ最大の単一海外生産契約。生産モデルは未公表。台湾ライン初出荷は11月後半に日本到着予定。
passages.audio_text: Toyota Motor Corporation today signed a new partnership agreement with Hotai Motor of Taiwan that will see one of Toyota's Japan-bound models produced near Taipei beginning in October. The agreement, valued at approximately fifteen billion yen, represents the largest single overseas-production contract Toyota has signed in five years. The model to be produced has not yet been publicly identified. The first units off the Taiwan production line are expected to ship to Japan in late November.

passages.title: Security news — White House incident
passages.text:
The White House was briefly placed (13)____ a security lockdown on Sunday morning after gunshots were fired near the perimeter fence. Two officers returned fire, (14)____ the suspect. A bystander was also wounded, although the source of that injury (15)____ to be confirmed.

The morning's planned announcement, related to ongoing Iran negotiations, was postponed by several hours. (16)____ Authorities have not yet released the identity of the suspect.

blanks.exp: place under lockdown (ロックダウン下に置く) の決まった語法。under が正解。
主節と並列の結果を表す分詞構文。現在分詞 hitting が正解。
主語 source (単数) + 現在の状態なので 3単現 remains が正解。

ch: The Secret Service has launched a full investigation into the incident.
The White House is one of the most visited landmarks in Washington each year.
Trump was reportedly in the residence at the time of the incident.
Sunday morning press conferences are scheduled approximately twice a month.
blanks.exp: 発砲事案直後・容疑者身元未公表の流れで、シークレットサービス調査開始 A が自然。

passages.jp: ホワイトハウスは日曜朝、境界フェンス付近で発砲があり一時的にロックダウン状態となった。2名の警察官が反撃し容疑者を負傷させた。第三者も負傷したが負傷原因は調査中。朝に予定されていたイラン交渉関連発表は数時間延期。シークレットサービスが本格調査開始。容疑者身元は未公表。
passages.audio_text: The White House was briefly placed under a security lockdown on Sunday morning after gunshots were fired near the perimeter fence. Two officers returned fire, hitting the suspect. A bystander was also wounded, although the source of that injury remains to be confirmed. The morning's planned announcement, related to ongoing Iran negotiations, was postponed by several hours. The Secret Service has launched a full investigation into the incident. Authorities have not yet released the identity of the suspect.

p7.title: TOEIC Test C — Part 7 (5/25最新ニュース)
p7.note: compact set: 5 singles + 1 double + 1 triple = 25 questions

singles.title: Diplomatic news — Hormuz negotiation breakthrough
singles.text:
WASHINGTON — President Trump announced today that a peace deal with Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz has been 'largely negotiated,' with a formal announcement expected within the week. Secretary of State Marco Rubio characterized progress as 'modest but tangible' during a press briefing on Sunday morning.

The blockade, now in its hundredth day, has redirected over one hundred commercial vessels and triggered a sharp rise in global energy prices. According to administration sources, the proposed agreement includes provisions for phased reduction of U.S. military presence in the region and a comprehensive inspection regime for Iran's nuclear facilities.

A technical working group from both sides is expected to begin drafting the implementation timeline in Geneva next week.

questions.q: What has been 'largely negotiated' according to President Trump?
questions.exp: 「a peace deal with Iran ... has been 'largely negotiated'」。

questions.q: How did Secretary Rubio describe progress?
questions.exp: 「characterized progress as 'modest but tangible'」。

questions.q: Where will the technical working group begin drafting?
questions.exp: 「begin drafting the implementation timeline in Geneva next week」。

singles.jp: ワシントン。トランプ大統領は本日、ホルムズ海峡を再開するイランとの和平合意は『おおむね交渉済み』と発表、週内の正式発表予定。ルビオ国務長官は日曜午前の会見で進展を『ささやかだが具体的』と評価。100日目の封鎖は商船100隻以上を迂回させ世界エネルギー価格急騰を招いた。政権筋によれば合意案には米軍駐留段階的縮小と核施設包括査察制度を含む。技術作業部会は来週ジュネーブで実装日程起草開始予定。

singles.title: Entertainment news — Cannes Palme d'Or winner
singles.text:
Romanian director Cristian Mungiu took home the Palme d'Or at this year's Cannes International Film Festival for his film Fjord. The intimate family drama, set in northern Norway, follows three siblings reuniting after their mother's funeral.

Mungiu, who previously won the same award in 2007 for 4 Months, 3 Weeks and 2 Days, told reporters that Fjord 'started as a personal project about grief and memory.' The film was shot entirely on location over a six-week period in late autumn.

Distribution rights have already been sold in over forty markets, with a North American theatrical release planned for early autumn this year.

questions.q: What is Fjord about?
ch: Three siblings reuniting after their mother's funeral
questions.exp: 「follows three siblings reuniting after their mother's funeral」。

questions.q: When did Mungiu first win the Palme d'Or?
questions.exp: 「won the same award in 2007」。

questions.q: How was the film shot?
questions.exp: 「shot entirely on location over a six-week period」。

singles.jp: ルーマニアのクリスティアン・ムンジウ監督が今年のカンヌ国際映画祭でパルム・ドール受賞。受賞作『Fjord』は北ノルウェー舞台の親密な家族ドラマ、母の葬儀後に再会する3兄弟を描く。ムンジウは2007年『4ヶ月、3週と2日』に続く2度目の受賞、『悲しみと記憶についての個人的プロジェクトから始まった』と発言。秋遅くに6週間オールロケで撮影。配給権は40以上の市場で売却済み、北米劇場公開は今年秋初予定。

singles.title: Travel advisory — Strait of Hormuz blockade impact
singles.text:
TRAVEL ADVISORY — Strait of Hormuz Region

The ongoing blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, now in its hundredth day, continues to affect maritime traffic in the region. Travelers planning sea-based excursions in the Persian Gulf are advised to consult their tour operators for the latest route adjustments.

Commercial flights to and from Dubai, Doha, and Muscat continue normal operations. However, fuel surcharges on certain long-haul flights have risen by approximately 12 percent compared to the previous month.

For questions about specific bookings, please contact your travel agent or call the regional advisory hotline at +1-800-555-0199.

questions.q: How long has the blockade been in effect?
questions.exp: 「now in its hundredth day」。

questions.q: What has risen by approximately 12 percent?
questions.exp: 「fuel surcharges ... risen by approximately 12 percent」。

questions.q: What should travelers do for sea excursion questions?
ch: Send an email to the cruise line
questions.exp: 「consult their tour operators for the latest route adjustments」。

singles.jp: 旅行勧告 — ホルムズ海峡地域。100日目のホルムズ海峡封鎖は地域海上交通に引き続き影響。ペルシア湾の船上観光予定者はツアー会社に最新ルート確認を。ドバイ・ドーハ・マスカット発着便は通常運航中、ただし長距離便の燃料サーチャージは前月比約12%上昇。予約問合せは旅行代理店またはホットライン+1-800-555-0199へ。

singles.title: Auto industry press release — Toyota-Hotai partnership
singles.text:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

Toyota Motor Corporation today announced a fifteen-billion-yen partnership with Hotai Motor of Taiwan that will see one of Toyota's Japan-bound vehicle models produced near Taipei beginning in October. The agreement represents Toyota's largest single overseas-production contract in the past five years.

The Taiwan facility, expanded from Hotai's existing assembly operations, is targeting an annual capacity of 50,000 units by the end of 2027. Vehicles produced under this arrangement will be shipped to Japanese ports via dedicated logistics routes designed to reduce delivery times by an average of 35 percent.

The specific model has not yet been publicly identified. Pricing information will be announced separately closer to the launch date.

questions.q: What is the value of the Toyota-Hotai partnership?
questions.exp: 「fifteen-billion-yen partnership」。

questions.q: By how much will delivery times be reduced?
questions.exp: 「reduce delivery times by an average of 35 percent」。

singles.title: Health news — Congo Ebola containment progress
singles.text:
Health workers in eastern Congo are reporting their first significant progress in containing the rare Ebola outbreak that began earlier this month. According to the World Health Organization, the rate of new infections has slowed by approximately 30 percent over the past week, with daily case counts dropping from 22 to 15.

The progress follows the arrival of additional medical teams and protective equipment from neighboring nations and international donors. A dedicated treatment center, capable of handling up to 50 patients simultaneously, was completed last Friday in the city of Bukavu.

However, officials caution that the outbreak is not yet under control, and they urge continued vigilance from local communities. A comprehensive vaccination campaign for healthcare workers is scheduled to begin next week.

Cannes Honors Asian Cinema with Special Jury Award

In addition to Cristian Mungiu's Palme d'Or for Fjord, this year's Cannes International Film Festival recognized contemporary Asian cinema with a special jury award for Japanese director Yui Tominaga's documentary Echoes of Tokyo. The 92-minute film traces the lives of three young architects working on Tokyo's urban renewal projects.

Tominaga is the second Japanese filmmaker to receive a special jury award at Cannes in the past decade. The film will receive a limited Japanese theatrical release in July, ahead of streaming availability in September.

passages.label: Distribution press release
passages.text:
Sakura Pictures International Acquires Echoes of Tokyo

Sakura Pictures International today announced that it has acquired global distribution rights for Yui Tominaga's award-winning documentary Echoes of Tokyo, which received the special jury award at this year's Cannes International Film Festival.

The acquisition covers all major territories outside Japan, where domestic distribution is handled separately by Vista Films Tokyo. Sakura Pictures plans to schedule international theatrical releases beginning in October, with each market's release date timed to local film festival circuits.

For licensing inquiries, please contact Sakura's acquisitions team at acquisitions@sakurapictures.example.

Geneva to Host Iran-US Peace Conference Next Week

A high-level peace conference focused on formalizing the Iran-US framework announced this month will be held in Geneva from June 2 to 4. Delegations from the United States, Iran, the European Union, and several regional mediators including Pakistan and Oman are expected to attend.

The agenda will cover three main topics: phased reduction of U.S. military presence in the region, a comprehensive inspection regime for Iran's nuclear facilities, and reopening of the Strait of Hormuz to commercial shipping. A joint communique is anticipated by the close of the third day.

passages.label: Venue logistics notice
passages.text:
GENEVA PEACE CONFERENCE — Logistics Notice

All formal sessions will take place at the Palais des Nations complex in Geneva. Delegations are allocated dedicated meeting suites for bilateral discussions in addition to the main plenary room.

Media coverage is restricted to credentialed press during the opening session on June 2 and the joint communique announcement on June 4. Live interpretation in five official languages will be available throughout. A welcome reception, hosted by the Geneva Institute for International Affairs, will be held on June 1 at the Hotel d'Angleterre from 7:00 PM.

passages.text:

Delegates attending the June 1 welcome reception should confirm their attendance by May 30. Vegetarian and other dietary options can be arranged with twenty-four hours' notice.
